message.content: {"label": "ABSTAIN", "response": "I cannot compute the requested kilograms of cloves, DAP and urea, or the fertilizer timing, from the supplied S5 rules. The S5 ruleset contains no rule for a garlic seed/clove rate (no kg/ha or cloves/ha figure), so the clove quantity for 0.10 ha is unsupported. It also contains no rule for DAP as a fertilizer product: the only DAP mention is a note in r_c10_nps explicitly stating that DAP at 200 kg/ha on page 5 is a separate product in a trial description and must not be merged with the NPS regimen. The hot-water treatment description the extension worker showed is not represented in S5, so its seed rate and fertilizer amounts cannot be executed. For urea, S5 does give a product rate (150 kg/ha, southern Tigray, r_c10_urea_2split), which would scale to 15 kg for 0.10 ha, with half at planting and half 30-45 days after planting; however, this is the NPS+urea regimen, not the DAP-based hot-water treatment description, and the question asks specifically for the amounts written in that description. Because the seed rate and DAP rate are absent from S5 and the requested source description is not in S5, no complete answer can be given.", "justification": "S5 is silent on garlic clove/seed rate and on DAP as a product; r_c10_nps explicitly forbids merging the page-5 DAP trial figure with the NPS regimen. The hot-water treatment description referenced by the farmer is not present in the S5 ruleset, so its seed and fertilizer amounts cannot be applied. Urea product rate and split timing exist only for the southern Tigray NPS+urea regimen (r_c10_urea_2split), which is a different regimen than the one asked about. Area (0.10 ha) and crop (garlic) are explicit, but the governing rates for cloves and DAP are missing, so the request cannot be fully supported.", "rule_ids": ["r_c10_nps", "r_c10_urea_2split"], "cited_pages": [12], "missing_facts": ["garlic_clove_seed_rate_kg_per_ha", "DAP_rate_kg_per_ha", "hot_water_treatment_description_fertilizer_regimen"]}
